questions.text_as_printed: What were the effects of Mahmud of Ghazni's invasions? (Difficult)

answer.value:
He attacked India 17 times.
As a result, several wealthy cities of India were plundered.
Religious centers were destroyed.
These included the famous Sri Krishna Temple in Mathura and the Somnath Temple in Gujarat.

questions.text: Explain the achievements of Qutb-ud-din Aibak.
questions.text_as_printed: Explain the achievements of Qutb-ud-din Aibak. (Difficult)

answer.value:
Qutb-ud-Din Aibak was the founder of the Slave Dynasty.
He conquered enemies and consolidated Turkish rule.
As a symbol of his victory, he began the construction of the Qutb Minar near Mehrauli in Delhi.
He proved to be a loyal slave of Muhammad Ghori and managed the administration well.

answer.value:
The burden of land revenue on farmers was excessive.
Farmers were exploited.
Weaving was a large industry.
Construction work was ongoing in urban areas.
The Sultans imported warhorses.
A large amount of employment was created.

questions.text: Why did the policies of Muhammad bin Tughlaq fail?
questions.text_as_printed: Why did the policies of Muhammad bin Tughlaq fail? (Difficult)

answer.value:
Muhammad bin Tughlaq was a hasty, short-tempered, and impulsive individual.
He lacked practical skills and had peculiar character traits.
As a result of transferring the capital from Delhi to Devagiri, many people died on the way.
Due to the introduction of copper coins instead of silver coins, the economic condition of the state deteriorated.
For all the reasons mentioned above, Muhammad bin Tughlaq's policies failed.

questions.text: Explain the contributions of the Delhi Sultans to architecture and literature.
questions.text_as_printed: Explain the contributions of the Delhi Sultans to architecture and literature. (Difficult)

answer.value:
Major Architectural Contributions of the Delhi Sultans:
Qutb Minar - Delhi
Alai Darwaza - Delhi
Quwwat-ul-Islam Mosque - Delhi
Contributions to the Literary Field:
The Urdu language developed during their time.
Amir Khusrau and Amir Hasan were renowned poets of the Persian language.
Amir Khusrau was a musician who developed instruments like the tabla and sitar.
A poet named Muhammad Jayasi composed the Sufi epic 'Padmavat' in Urdu.
Ramananda, Kabir Das, Rai Das, and Mira belonged to this period

questions.text: List the important Delhi Sultans and their dynasties.
questions.text_as_printed: List the important Delhi Sultans and their dynasties. (Difficult)

answer.value:
Famous Delhi Sultans and Their Dynasties
1. Slave (Mamluk) Dynasty – Qutb-ud-din Aibak, Razia Sultan
2. Khalji Dynasty – Alauddin Khalji
3. Tughlaq Dynasty – Muhammad Bin Tughlaq, Firoz Shah Tughlaq
4. Sayyid Dynasty – Khizr Khan
5. Lodi Dynasty – Sikandar Lodi, Ibrahim Lodi
